entries.head: narrow down

senses.en: to reduce the number of choices

example.en: We narrowed it down to two apartments.
example.zh: 我们筛到只剩两套公寓。

entries.l1_note: 缩小范围是 narrow down；narrow 单独是窄的。

entries.head: decide against

senses.en: to choose not to do something

example.en: We decided against the bigger apartment.
example.zh: 我们决定不要那套大公寓了。

entries.l1_note: 决定不做是 decide against；decide on 是选定。

entries.head: go through with

senses.en: to do something you planned despite doubts

example.en: She went through with the move despite the cost.
example.zh: 虽然贵她还是搬了。

entries.l1_note: 做到底是 go through with；go through 是经历。

entries.head: come down to

senses.en: when the real issue is one thing

example.en: It comes down to whether we can afford it.
example.zh: 说到底就是我们买不买得起。

entries.l1_note: 归结为是 come down to；boil down to 同义。

entries.head: size up

senses.en: to look at something and judge it

example.en: She sized up the room before choosing a seat.
example.zh: 她扫了一眼房间才挑座位。

entries.l1_note: 打量是 size up；不是“量尺寸”。

entries.head: chew over

senses.en: to think about something carefully over time

example.en: I'll chew it over and call you tomorrow.
example.zh: 我琢磨琢磨，明天给你电话。

entries.l1_note: 反复琢磨是 chew over；mull over 同义。

entries.head: toss around

senses.en: to discuss ideas casually

example.en: We tossed around a few names for the project.
example.zh: 我们随便聊了几个项目名。

entries.l1_note: 随便讨论是 toss around；toss out 是扔掉。

entries.head: bat around

senses.en: to discuss an idea from several angles

example.en: They batted the proposal around for an hour.
example.zh: 他们把提案来回讨论了一小时。

entries.l1_note: bat around 来自棒球，画面是互相打来打去。

entries.head: thrash out

senses.en: to discuss something until you agree

example.en: They thrashed out the details overnight.
example.zh: 他们连夜把细节谈定了。

entries.l1_note: 争出结果是 thrash out；不是“打出来”。

entries.head: hit on

senses.en: to suddenly think of an idea

example.en: She hit on a much cheaper solution.
example.zh: 她突然想到一个便宜得多的办法。

entries.l1_note: 突然想到是 hit on；hit on someone 是搭讪。

entries.head: jump at

senses.en: to accept an offer immediately

example.en: I jumped at the chance to work abroad.
example.zh: 我立刻抓住了出国的机会。

entries.l1_note: 立刻接受是 jump at；jump in 是插话。

entries.head: leap at

senses.en: to accept eagerly

example.en: She leapt at the chance to lead the team.
example.zh: 她立刻接下了带团队的机会。

entries.l1_note: leap at 和 jump at 同义，稍书面。

entries.head: pass up

senses.en: to not take an opportunity

example.en: He passed up a job in Shenzhen to stay home.
example.zh: 他放弃了深圳的工作留在家里。

entries.l1_note: 放弃机会是 pass up；pass on 是转达。

entries.head: win over

senses.en: to get someone to support you

example.en: She won over the skeptics with a demo.
example.zh: 她用一次演示说服了持怀疑的人。

entries.l1_note: 争取过来是 win over；win out 是最终胜出。

entries.head: scare off

senses.en: to make someone lose interest

example.en: The high price scared off most buyers.
example.zh: 高价吓跑了大部分买家。

entries.l1_note: 吓跑是 scare off / scare away。

entries.head: sit on

senses.en: to delay dealing with something

example.en: You can't sit on this request all week.
example.zh: 这个申请你不能压一周。

entries.l1_note: 压着是 sit on；sit in 是旁听。

entries.head: put on hold

senses.en: to delay something for now

example.en: The trip is on hold until the budget clears.
example.zh: 预算批下来之前旅行先搁着。

entries.l1_note: 搁置是 put on hold；hold on 是别挂电话。

entries.head: think ahead

senses.en: to plan for the future

example.en: Think ahead — where do you want to be in five years?
example.zh: 往前想想，五年后你想在哪？

entries.l1_note: 提前想是 think ahead；think back 是回想。

entries.head: look ahead

senses.en: to consider what will happen next

example.en: Looking ahead, the schedule gets tight in May.
example.zh: 往后看，五月的日程会很紧。

entries.l1_note: 往前看是 look ahead；look back 是回顾。

entries.head: plan ahead

senses.en: to make plans in advance

example.en: Plan ahead if you want cheap tickets.
example.zh: 想买便宜票就得提前计划。

entries.l1_note: 提前计划是 plan ahead；plan out 是排细节。

entries.head: rule in

senses.en: to consider something possible

example.en: We can't rule in the cheaper plan until we test it.
example.zh: 便宜方案没测过之前不能算进来。

entries.l1_note: 纳入考虑是 rule in；rule out 是排除。

entries.head: factor in

senses.en: to include something in your planning

example.en: Factor in the commute before you take the job.
example.zh: 接这份工作前把通勤算进去。

entries.l1_note: 算进去是 factor in；factor 是因素。

entries.head: weigh against

senses.en: to compare one thing with another

example.en: Weigh the salary against the hours you'll work.
example.zh: 把工资和工作时长放一起比。

entries.l1_note: 权衡是 weigh A against B；weigh up 是整体权衡。
collocations: weigh the pros against the cons

entries.head: trade off

senses.en: to accept a disadvantage to get an advantage

example.en: You trade off space for a shorter commute here.
example.zh: 在这儿是用面积换更短的通勤。

entries.l1_note: 取舍是 trade off；名词是 trade-off。

entries.head: balance out

senses.en: when advantages and disadvantages cancel out

example.en: The extra pay balances out the longer hours.
example.zh: 多给的工资抵得上多干的时间。

entries.l1_note: 扯平是 balance out；balance 是平衡。

entries.head: think back

senses.en: to remember the past

example.en: Think back to when you first moved here.
example.zh: 回想你刚搬来的时候。

entries.l1_note: 回想是 think back (to)；think ahead 是往前想。

entries.head: look back

senses.en: to think about the past

example.en: Looking back, I should have taken the offer.
example.zh: 回头看，我当时该接那个 offer。

entries.l1_note: 回顾是 look back (on)；look ahead 是往前看。

entries.head: hash over

senses.en: to discuss something again in detail

example.en: They hashed over the budget for the third time.
example.zh: 他们第三次把预算翻出来讨论。

entries.l1_note: 反复讨论是 hash over（美式）；hash out 是谈定。

entries.head: kick around

senses.en: to discuss an idea informally

example.en: We kicked around the idea of a podcast.
example.zh: 我们随便聊了聊做播客的想法。

entries.l1_note: 随便聊是 kick around；kick off 是启动。

entries.head: play with

senses.en: to consider an idea without deciding

example.en: I'm playing with the idea of moving back.
example.zh: 我在考虑搬回去这件事。

entries.l1_note: 考虑想法是 play with the idea；play around 是瞎试。
